name: reginald-perrin
reference_text: It didn't. Is that wise? No. As your speech coming along, Mr. Frank, I'm going to put you up to any good news, thank you. I'm sure you're going to give a wonderful report. Yes, I'm going to be vague. Not that anybody listens to it, of course. I often have the impression that everyone listens to a single word, I say.
